description: Does this text fit: SMS segments, X posts, store listings, ad and push limits — Checks up to 50 texts per call against a platform limit, for an agent writing a message, post, store listing, ad or push payload that must not be truncated or split. sms: GSM 7 bit vs UCS-2 and the exact segment boundaries per 3GPP TS 23.038 (extension characters cost 2 septets and never straddle a segment; an emoji is 2 UTF-16 units). x: weighted length per the open-source twitter-text config v3

field.description: app-store: name, subtitle, keywords, promotional-text, description. google-play: app-name, short-description, full-description. google-ads: rsa-headline, rsa-description, rsa-path. apns: payload, voip-payload. fcm: payload. Not used by sms and x.

maxSegments.description: sms only: the number of segments you accept (default 1).

platform.description: sms, x, app-store, google-play, google-ads, apns, fcm.

text.description: Up to 60000 characters in total. For apns/fcm pass the serialized JSON payload.

name: platform-text-fit
